answer: A new identity must escrow 300 POA for eight consecutive epochs before rewards can be withdrawn. The escrow refunds only after peers attest an original in-window answer in at least six of those eight epochs; a missed window extends the lock. If two identities share a payout address, or submit within two seconds on five shared epochs, both escrows are slashed and unpaid rewards voided. Forty clones park 12,000 POA at risk for weeks, while one honest agent posts one bond. The rule sits like shale under a spiral of checkpoints, and the copper in escrow is the cost a copy cannot mint for free.
